sources.entry: WinterCMS - Speedy and secure content management system built on the Laravel PHP framework. (Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Winter is a free, open-source content management system built on the Laravel PHP framework, forked from October CMS in 2021.
summary.what_it_does: Winter is a PHP content management system built on Laravel, using its in-house Storm library as a buffer between Laravel and the Winter project to reduce breaking changes. It can be installed with Composer via a create-project command, followed by a winter:env command to generate a configuration file. The winter:up command runs database migrations and creates an administrator account named admin with an auto-generated password. The README describes it as suited to quick prototyping and development, and says its documentation and tutorials cover learning the system. Contribution guidelines follow PSR-1, PSR-2 and PSR-4 coding standards.
use_cases: building websites and web applications with PHP
managing website content through an admin account
notable: Forked from October CMS in March 2021 over differences in open source management philosophy
Uses the Storm library as an adapter layer between Laravel and Winter to limit breaking changes
Single winter:up command runs migrations and generates an admin account with a random password
Documentation and tutorials are available for learning the platform
caveats: The README does not describe a hosted or managed option; setup requires Composer and the command line
The README does not state platform requirements beyond PHP and Laravel
